text:
The biggest cause of death in children under five in 2017 was complications of preterm birth, at about 16% of under-5 deaths. Lower respiratory infections, mainly pneumonia, were a close second at roughly 15%, and they were the leading cause for children aged 1 to 59 months. I'm reasoning from WHO/IHME figures from memory, so I haven't checked them against the source.

CONFIDENCE: 75
